notes: Two branches («ح») join at the father: «حدثنا أبي» is the father of Ubayd Allah, and the first branch names «معاذ بن معاذ»; the reader does not decide whether they are one man, so both stand as written.
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss; left out.
«قال شعبة قلت لعدي سمعته من البراء قال إياى حدث» is Shu'ba's aside about hearing; not a route, left out.
